senses.gloss: (v. מְאַס) to be sticky, soiled; to be repulsive (cmp. זהם).
units: <cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Psalms 38:6">Targ. Ps. XXXVIII, 6</cite> (Ms. <he>איתימסיו</he>, v. <cite ref="M01841"><he>מְסִי</he></cite>).—
<cite ref="Bava Kamma 18a:3">B. Kam. 18ᵃ</cite> <he>דמ׳ בלישא</he> (not <he>דמאוס</he>), v. <cite ref="F00030"><he>ווּס</he></cite>.—Part. <cite ref="M00028"><he>מָאִיס</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Psalms 58:9">Targ. Ps. LVIII, 9</cite> (ed. Wil. <cite ref="M00049"><he>מָאַס</he></cite>, read <cite ref="M00049"><he>מָאִס</he></cite>).—
<cite ref="Ketubot 63b:7">Keth. 63ᵇ</cite> <he>מ׳ עלי</he> he is repulsive to me.
<cite ref="Yoma 63b:13">Yoma 63ᵇ</cite> <he>משום דמ׳</he> because it is offensive (on account of blemishes).—

<cite ref="Berakhot 50b:11">Ber. 50ᵇ</cite> <he>מידי דלא מ׳</he> Ms. M. (ed. <he>מִמְּאִיס</he>) something which is not sticky (the handling of which does not create aversion); a. e.—Pl. <he>מְאִיסִין</he>, <he>מְאִיסֵי</he>.
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Deuteronomy 28:13">Targ. Y. Deut. XXVIII, 13</cite> (opp. <he>מנטלין</he>).—
<cite ref="Yevamot 100a:1">Yeb. 100ᵃ</cite> <he>משום דמ׳</he> because they (the uncircumcised and the unclean) are rejected on account of their physical condition; a. e.—

<cite ref="Eichah Rabbah 3">Lam. R. to III, 45</cite> (transl. <he>סחי ומאוס</he>, <cite ref="Eichah Rabbah 3">ib.</cite>) <he>מְאִסַיָּיא פְּסִילַיָּיא</he> loathsome, outcasts, v. <cite ref="Q01287"><he>פְּסִילָא</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Pesachim 28a:7">Pes. 28ᵃ</cite> <he>חמץ דמִמְּאִיס</he> Ms. M. 1 (Ms. M. 2 <he>דמאיס</he>; ed. <he>דמִמִּיס</he>) leavened matter which decays in course of time; <cite ref="Pesachim 28a">ib.</cite> <he>ע״א דלא ממאיס</he> Ms. M. 1 (Ms. M. 2 <cite ref="M00029"><he>מאיסה</he></cite>; ed. <he>מִמִּיסָה</he>, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note) an idolatrous object which is not subject to decay.
